explanation: Generated a one-point eta-channel EXCLURAD input for W=1.600 GeV, Q2=1.000 GeV2, cos(theta*)=0.500, and phi*=90.0 degrees. It uses model 3 (EtaMAID-2023), full O(alpha) corrections, a 6.53 GeV electron beam, a stationary proton target, detected recoil proton (ivec=1), and vcut=0.166 GeV2, the documented standard CLAS12 eta settings. The point is physical: W is above the p-eta threshold and the implied scattered-electron kinematics are allowed. A numerical radiative-correction value was not computed because this workspace has no compiler or executable runtime; run the eta EXCLURAD executable from this directory, where it reads input.dat and writes radcor.dat.
